description: This file implements a Perl module 'Git::SVN::Editor' which is a specialized driver for integrating git with Subversion using the SVN::Delta::Editor interface. It facilitates translating git tree diffs into SVN commit operations, primarily used internally by the 'git svn' command to communicate changes to an SVN repository.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Editor
classes.description: A Perl class that extends SVN::Delta::Editor to implement a commit driver for 'git svn', translating changes from git trees into SVN repository operations.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Editor object with options, generating diffs and setting up the environment.

methods.name: generate_diff
methods.description: Generates a diff between two git trees, returning the list of modifications.

methods.name: check_diff_paths
methods.description: Checks and caches the SVN path types for diff paths to optimize SVN::check_path calls.

methods.name: split_path
methods.description: Splits a repository path into directory and filename components.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Gets the repository path, converting to UTF-8 if encoding is configured.

methods.name: url_path
methods.description: Constructs the full URL path in SVN for a given repository path.

methods.name: rmdirs
methods.description: Removes directories in the SVN working copy that are marked for deletion.

methods.name: open_or_add_dir
methods.description: Opens an existing directory or adds a new one in the SVN working copy.

methods.name: ensure_path
methods.description: Ensures that the directory path exists in the working copy, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: glob2pat

methods.name: check_attr

methods.name: apply_manualprops
